description: This header file declares internal utility functions related to cryptographic big number manipulations, conversion between internal representations and OpenSSL BIGNUMs, and handling of prime and integer data structures for cryptographic purposes within the ANSC framework.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubPrime2BigNum
methods.description: Converts a custom prime structure to an OpenSSL BIGNUM object.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubInteger2BigNum
methods.description: Converts a custom integer structure to an OpenSSL BIGNUM object.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubBigEndianInteger2Integer
methods.description: Converts a big-endian integer into the internal integer representation.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubBigEndianPrime2Prime
methods.description: Converts a big-endian prime into the internal prime representation.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubBigNum2Integer
methods.description: Converts an OpenSSL BIGNUM into the internal integer representation.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubBigNum2Prime
methods.description: Converts an OpenSSL BIGNUM into the internal prime structure.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubSetInteger
methods.description: Initializes an internal integer structure from binary data.

methods.name: AnscCryptoPubSetPrime
methods.description: Initializes an internal prime structure from binary data.
